summary: Backend API regression passed 10/10 tests. UI login, dashboard, search, book/member creation, and card preview passed; circulation QR interaction blocked by an overlay and the remaining dependent UI flow could not be completed.

critical.issue: Six consecutive invalid passwords remain ordinary 401 responses; no brute-force lockout after five failures as required by the auth playbook.

ui_bugs.issue: The decorative .scan-corners element intercepts pointer events, so the visible Buka pemindai QR button cannot be clicked normally. Force-click testing also did not reliably change the state.
mobile-menu-button has no onClick behavior in App.js, so the sidebar cannot be opened on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: Siswa still sees the add-book mutation control even though the API correctly returns 403; hide or disable unauthorized mutation controls.
Reports UI renders hardcoded incoming/missing rows and does not consume /api/reports, so API data cannot flow into those tabs.

action_items: Fix pointer-events/z-index for .scan-corners so the QR button is clickable.
Gate book/member mutation controls by the logged-in role.
Load incoming and missing report data from /api/reports instead of hardcoded arrays.
Add account lockout/rate limiting after five failed login attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports endpoint exists but the frontend never calls it; this is a direct integration gap.
delete_book returns success even when no book was deleted, which can mislead the UI for nonexistent IDs.
JWT_SECRET has a short insecure fallback and backend logs emit PyJWT InsecureKeyLengthWarning; production configuration should fail fast on a missing sufficiently long secret.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_ book; created one TEST_ member for persistence testing. Additional UI-created TEST records may remain because the UI flow was interrupted before cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth roles, cookie/me/logout, catalog CRUD, member persistence, dashboard, reports API, and invalid transaction handling passed. Re-test QR click without force, mobile navigation, student permissions, and frontend report data after fixes.
rca of the issue: QR circulation is blocked because .scan-corners is an absolutely positioned child covering the scanner area without pointer-events:none, intercepting clicks intended for the button. The report mismatch is caused by Reports using local hardcoded arrays rather than loading /api/reports.
